_: phiogy.com, laid the way Discord lays its site: a top bar and a footer round every page (`top`, `foot`), the home (a split hero with figures standing round the app, site cards that take turns, a band of running words, the call to come in, a lineup), and the pages its links lead to: download, support (Phiogy's own help file), docs, news, about and the policies. Pictures: fresh captures of the web Phiogy (media store phiogy/shot/) and the mannequins of Phiegg's home page (phiegg:home/dress/).

blocks.heading: Your club, all in one place
blocks.body: Phiogy is where clubs and their people hang out: rooms to write in, rooms to talk in, calls with camera and screen, and everyone one tap away.

blocks.heading: A home for every club
blocks.body: Each club and company keeps a host of its own, with text rooms, voice rooms and its people. Join the hosts you follow, or make yours in a minute.

blocks.heading: Drop in and talk
blocks.body: Voice rooms are always open. Walk into the Lounge, see who is there, and start talking; nothing is kept.

blocks.heading: Everyone is one tap away
blocks.body: Every face opens a profile: who they are, what they make and where they hang out. Message them, follow them, ask them to be friends.

blocks.heading: Find your people
blocks.body: Search anyone by name and start a conversation, or a call with camera, microphone and screen for up to 8 people.

blocks.heading: That is the end of the page. Come hang out.
Get Phiogy
blocks.subtitle: Phiogy for Windows: the same hosts, rooms and calls as in your browser, in a window of its own.

items.q: What does the Windows app need?
items.a: Windows 10 or 11 and a graphics card with DirectX 11.
No. Phiogy is a folder you keep where you like, with phiogy.exe and its asset folder beside it.

items.q: Windows says it protected my PC. What do I do?
items.a: Phiogy is not signed yet, so Windows does not know its publisher. Press More info, then Run anyway. The window opens in front within a few seconds.
Not yet. Open Phiogy in your browser: your hosts, rooms and calls are the same there.

items.title: phiogy.com grows up
items.body: Support, docs, news and the policies, a tap from the top bar and the footer, on a phone as well as a desk.

blocks.lead: Phiogy is where clubs and their people hang out: rooms to write in, rooms to talk in, calls with camera and screen, and everyone one tap away.

sections.title: Part of Phiace
sections.body: Phiogy is one of Phiace's apps, with Phiegg, Phipad and Phisum. One account opens all of them.

sections.title: One server
sections.body: It runs on Phiora, the same server as phiegg.com, so a host, a room or a call is the same in the Windows app and in the browser.

blocks.lead: A plain summary while the full terms are written.

sections.title: Using Phiogy
sections.body: Use Phiogy lawfully, and follow the guidelines in every host and room you are in.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: Keep your password to yourself. One account opens every Phi app.

blocks.lead: What Phiogy keeps, in plain words.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: Your handle, your name and your password. An email only if you add one: it is how a forgotten password comes back.

sections.title: Calls
sections.body: The microphone and camera are used only while you are in a call.

blocks.lead: How we keep Phiogy a good place to hang out.

sections.title: Be kind
sections.body: Talk to people the way you would want to be talked to. No harassment, threats or hate.

sections.title: Respect privacy
sections.body: Do not share someone's messages, pictures or files without asking them.

sections.title: Keep it legal
sections.body: Nothing unlawful, in a room, a call or a file.

sections.title: Tell someone
sections.body: When something is wrong in a host, tell its administrators.

foot.body: The village of creators: clubs, their rooms and their people, on your desk and in your browser.
